lines: 荒芜废墟之上。
当神州的战士用人命把战线横推到末世终局之战的舞台的时候，己方阵营中那位年迈的人族最强者却已气血枯竭。
那一刻，绝望，成为这片世界的主色调。
“没有希望了吗？”
拼光了所有人命，最后止步于终局战场门前的只剩寥寥三名残兵败将。
他们中有人丢下破碎的兵戈，拖着千疮百孔的身躯，挣扎着爬向那片神台。
明明已经无力再战，但作为这片世界最后的遗孤，他必须给死去的同胞一个交代。
哪怕只有一秒钟也好，他必须穿过那片迷雾，站到那邪神的面前去。
只有死在那里，才算没有辜负自己背后的百万伏尸。
“不好意思，让一让”
“让一让，很急。”
“借过一下！”
一个夹带着粗重喘息的声音从后方传来。
就在三名濒死的战士艰难拖动残躯攀向高地的时候，一个身披怪异甲胄的男人忽然从后方堆积的死尸里跑了出来。
画风开始突变。
这人头上戴着法王的头冠，身上是滚圆的巨人王铠甲，背上扛着一大一小两面盾牌，下半身是一条奇怪的短裤，脚上穿着豪华版的王室骑兵靴，左手是恶魔小镰刀，右手灭世法杖。
顶级到不能再顶级的一身装备，以极度诡异的方式搭配在同一个人身上，最后呈现出来一种拼多多的廉价既视感。
这个奇怪的男人快速的穿过战场的复杂地形，遍地的尸骸、焚烧的战车，都没能阻碍他半分，始终如履平地。
奔跑过程中，他仅用几次随意的侧身和翻滚，就避开了所有障碍物。
神州大地的所有战士用血肉蹚出来的这条路，在他这里却好像已经走过无数次了。
男人一路狂奔，无视了周遭的一切，只在那三名濒死的战士身上跨过的时候说了几声：
“借过借过。”
三步并作两步，十分轻盈地冲到了终局之战的迷雾之前，他停住了脚步。
然后，在三名濒死战士的注视之下，他开始了一系列嗑药、施法附魔的举动。
各种奇异的色彩、图腾开始在男人身上、头顶汇聚。
他的气势开始急速攀升。
在重重附魔和各种灵药异宝的加持下，男人在短短几十秒内焕发出了族群最强者也不曾企及的恐怖威压，举手投足所产生的力量波动让整片天地为之战栗。
最后，在濒死的战士们目瞪口呆的瞩目下，男人踏入了迷雾。
那一刻，世界仿佛重新燃起了希望。
终局战场。
邪神感应到了那命中注定的敌手终于现身，发出了畅快的笑声：
“哈哈哈！
三千年了！
终于又有人能站到本座面前，让我看看三千年时间筛选出的究竟是……”
【跳过过场动画】
邪神的声音戛然而止。
content_en:
On top of the desolate ruins.
When the warriors of China sacrificed their lives to push the battle front to the stage of the final battle of the apocalypse, the old and strongest human being in their own camp had exhausted his energy and blood.
At that moment, despair became the main color of this world.
"Is there no hope?"
After all the lives were spent, only three defeated soldiers were left in front of the final battlefield.
Some of them dropped their broken weapons, dragged their bodies riddled with holes, and struggled to crawl toward the altar.
It is clear that he is unable to fight anymore, but as the last orphan in this world, he must give an explanation to his dead compatriots.
Even if it was only for a second, he had to go through the fog and stand in front of the evil god.
Only by dying there can you live up to the millions of corpses lying behind you.
"Sorry, give in"
"Give way, it's urgent."
"Borrow it!"
A voice with heavy breathing came from behind.
Just as the three dying warriors struggled to drag their remains to the high ground, a man wearing strange armor suddenly ran out from the dead bodies piled behind.
The style of painting began to change.
This man wears the crown of the Dharma King on his head, a round giant king's armor on his body, a large and a small shield on his back, a strange pair of shorts on his lower body, luxurious royal cavalry boots on his feet, a small devil's scythe in his left hand, and a world-destroying staff in his right hand.
The top-notch equipment is matched on the same person in an extremely weird way, and finally presents a sense of cheap déjà vu like Pinduoduo.
This strange man quickly passed through the complex terrain of the battlefield. The corpses and burning chariots everywhere did not hinder him in the slightest. He always walked on level ground.
During the run, he avoided all obstacles with only a few casual sideways and rolls.
This road that all the warriors in the land of China have trodden with their own flesh and blood seems to have been walked by him countless times.
The man ran wildly, ignoring everything around him, and only said a few words as he stepped over the three dying soldiers:
"Borrowed, borrowed."
Taking three steps and two steps at a time, he rushed very lightly to the fog of the final battle, and stopped.
Then, under the watchful eyes of three dying warriors, he began a series of actions such as taking drugs and casting spells.
"Tsk!"
"Phew!"
"Bang——"
"Uh-huh!"
Various strange colors and totems began to gather on the man's body and head.
His momentum began to rise rapidly.
With the blessing of numerous enchantments and various elixirs and rare treasures, in just a few dozen seconds, the man radiated a terrifying pressure that even the strongest members of the tribe could not match. The power fluctuations produced by his movements made the whole world tremble.
Finally, under the stunned gaze of the dying soldiers, the man stepped into the fog.
At that moment, hope seemed to reignite in the world.
The final battlefield.
The evil god sensed that his destined opponent had finally appeared and let out a hearty laugh:
"Hahaha!
Three thousand years!
Finally, someone can stand in front of me and let me see what has been screened out for three thousand years..."
[Skip cutscene]
The evil god's voice stopped abruptly.
